$meta.name: Travel app design tokens: sprint 10 additions
$meta.status: Proposal for Raz (docs/design/sprint-10/README.md section 33). Additions only, nothing changed or removed. No new colour value: every hex below already exists in tokens.json 0.10.0 or in apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts.
color.entry.note: Already in apps/mobile/src/theme/tokens.ts as entryRestrictedBg/Fg and entryBannedBg/Fg since sprint 4 but never added to tokens.json. Added here with the same values so the admin panel's CSS variables come from one source (README 29). tokens.test.mjs should then check them too.
color.passport.banner.map: No new colours. Red (expired_before_departure): bg color.<scheme>.status.alert.subtleBg, title status.alert.subtleFg, body text.primary, 4dp start bar status.alert.bg, AlertIcon. Orange (short_on_return): bg color.<scheme>.entry.restricted.bg, title entry.restricted.fg, body text.primary, 4dp start bar action.cta.bg, WarningIcon; in dark also a 1dp border.control outline (its bg equals status.info in dark). README 6.3, contrast 33.2.
color.passport.reminder.map: No new colours. status.info.subtleBg / subtleFg, no bar, no warning icon (README 6.4).
color.passport.autoTag.map: Detected: status.success.subtleBg / subtleFg with CheckIcon 12 (it says 'the reading worked', not 'safe'). Corrected by hand: bg.tag / text.secondary (README 9.2).
color.capture.note: Camera, confirm and photo viewer are always dark in both themes (a document photo on a white canvas glares, and it matches the globe's space). Values reused: globe.final.atmosphere.spaceColor, globe.final.discover.dim (0.55), night.25, sky.300 (= color.dark.action.primary.bg), lagoon.300. The MRZ band needs its dark underlay: alone it is 2.1:1 over a white page (README 33.2). Hints sit on color.toast.* pills, never straight on the image.
layout.capture.note: frameRatio = ICAO 9303 TD3 / ID-3 data page, 125 x 88 mm. frameTop is a fraction of the window height; mrzBandHeight a fraction of the frame height (bottom of the frame). shutterBottom is above insets.bottom. The frame and band never mirror in RTL (README 15).
limits.passport.note: nameMax reuses limits.profile.nameMax. holdersMax is a proposal (README 3.1). Counted in code points after trim, as the other name limits.
motion.passport.note: Reduced motion: no flash, colour changes instantly, viewer and banners appear without animation. Banners never animate when the trip opens (critical information, spec 12.3). Nothing delays the shutter (README 16).
web.cssVar.rule: apps/admin reads tokens as CSS custom properties generated from docs/design/tokens.json: the key with dots turned into dashes, camelCase into kebab-case, and the 'light.' theme segment dropped (color.light.text.primary -> --color-text-primary; color.light.status.success.subtleBg -> --color-status-success-subtle-bg). Only the light theme in sprint 10; dark (prefers-color-scheme) is a proposal and would reuse the same names. Non-colour keys keep their path (radius.md -> --radius-md, space.4 -> --space-4, motion.duration.short -> --motion-duration-short). README 29.
rules.passport.note: NOT tokens (business rules, next to passportVerdict and the shared validators): default 6 months; passport_validity_months 0..12, 0 = valid until the return day; red when expiry < start; orange when start <= expiry < addMonths(end, months); reminders 9/6/3 months before expiry at 09:00 device time, past dates not scheduled; MCT 15..360 minutes; entry_note <= 500; missions stale after 90 days.
